title: Write the 'Run Your Next Cohort Without Limits' campaign landing page copy
description:
Write complete, production-ready landing page copy for the 'Run Your Next Cohort Without Limits' acquisition campaign targeting Nigerian bootcamp founders and program managers.

Include:
1. Hero section: Headline ('Run Your Next Cohort Without Limits'), Subhead ('Fewer tools, smarter learning'), and dual CTA ('Start Free' / 'Explore Pro').
2. Pain points section: Contrast scattered tools (Slack + Zoom + Drive) with an all-in-one cohort workspace.
3. Feature blocks: Integrated live classes & recordings, AI study assistants that support instructors, role-based spaces, and assignment tracking.
4. Proof points & stats: '10,000+ learners', '98% educator satisfaction', '3x faster coordination', and '40% less admin workload'.
5. Transparent pricing section: Stress flat Naira pricing with no per-student fees.

Deliver ready-to-publish markdown in the attachment with SEO title, meta description, and verified claims from zedu.chat.
rationale: Directly implements the project brief's primary campaign focus ('Run Your Next Cohort Without Limits') to acquire bootcamp and cohort program managers in Nigeria.
reviewBlocker: The task has no delivery waiting for review.
